command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $s=(Get-Command ssh -ErrorAction Stop).Source; $a='shopvivaliz-vm'; $cmd=@'
set -e
p=/home/ubuntu/shopvivaliz-deploy/current
r=$(readlink -f "$p")
echo REALPATH=$r
sha=""
if git -C "$p" rev-parse HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1; then sha=$(git -C "$p" rev-parse HEAD); fi
if [ -z "$sha" ]; then
  for f in "$p/.deploy-sha" "$p/DEPLOY_SHA" "$p/REVISION" "$p/revision.txt" "$r/.deploy-sha" "$r/DEPLOY_SHA" "$r/REVISION" "$r/revision.txt"; do
    if [ -f "$f" ]; then sha=$(head -n1 "$f" | tr -cd '0-9a-fA-F' | cut -c1-40); [ -n "$sha" ] && break; fi
  done
fi
if [ -z "$sha" ]; then
  b=$(basename "$r"); c=$(printf '%s' "$b" | grep -Eo '[0-9a-fA-F]{7,40}' | head -n1 || true); [ -n "$c" ] && sha=$c
fi
[ -n "$sha" ] || sha=UNKNOWN
echo DEPLOY_SHA=$sha
'@; $o=& $s -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=15 $a $cmd 2>$null; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'SSH deploy metadata probe failed'}; $o | ForEach-Object {Write-Output $_}
reason: Resolve production deploy SHA safely from existing release metadata or symlink target without exposing secrets or changing production
